faq_intro: Questions about buying motorcycle spare parts for Bangladesh.
faqs: Can I order spares for different models in one shipment?
Yes. We pack mixed orders by model and label each carton, which makes unloading and stocking easier at your warehouse.
Do you manufacture the spares you sell?
Yes. Our spares are produced in our own facility in Delhi under IATF 16949 quality systems, rather than resold from other sources.
Can your team help me pick parts?
Yes. Share your model list and our staff will recommend suitable parts and quantities for your shop or warehouse.
How are spare parts shipped to Bangladesh?
By sea in palletised export packing, as FCL or LCL depending on volume, with the invoice, packing list and documents your clearing agent needs.
Can I start with a smaller first order?
Yes. We can suggest a balanced first order and adjust later shipments as you learn which models sell fastest.
Do you offer private label packaging?
Yes. Cartons can carry your brand and part numbers for resale in Bangladesh.
